title: Mars' Toxic Soil

scenes.text: NASA's Mars Curiosity finds 3% toxic soil
Most people believe Mars soil is harmless
scenes.label: Harmless Soil

scenes.text: Actually, Mars soil contains perchlorates, a toxic chemical
scenes.label: Toxic Perchlorates

scenes.text: This discovery changes our understanding of Martian soil composition
scenes.label: Soil Discovery

scenes.text: Follow if curiosity runs your brain.

description: NASA's Mars Curiosity rover has found toxic soil on the Red Planet. This changes our understanding of Martian soil composition. Follow for daily science!
